title: Arches of chaos, heteroclinic connections of first-order MMRs and the chaotic transport of small bodies in the Sun-Jupiter system
summary: We investigate the heteroclinic connections between stable and unstable manifolds of unstable periodic orbits associated with the most important mean motion resonances (MMRs) in the Sun-Jupiter planar restricted three-body problem. We explicitly compute the stable and unstable manifolds of the unstable periodic orbits associated with the first order interior MMRs 2:1, 3:2, and the exterior MMR 2:3.
